SearchAliases: every day is a good day
Senses.Note: After the fifteenth day is the second half of Yunmen’s test: he refuses discussion of before the fifteenth and demands one line for after it. Later masters re-raise and alter this frame.

ExplanationParts.CorpusEarnedOpening: After the fifteenth day is the second half of Yunmen’s fixed before-and-after test: he refuses discussion of before the fifteenth and demands one line for after it. Later masters re-raise and alter this calendrical frame.
EvidenceBody: one half of Yunmen’s fixed before-and-after case: original demand and later reprises retain the calendar boundary
After fixes the second side of the date boundary; the date alone can be ordinary calendrical prose.
Before the fifteenth is the paired first half and every day is a good day is Yunmen’s self-answer, not a second sense.
